name: 化け狐
hook:
A fox that lives
long enough learns
to fool humans.
lore:
In Japanese folklore, an old fox
grows extra tails and learns
to take human form.
Pale blue lights on a night road
are called kitsunebi, fox fire.
omen:
Try being a different you.
A new route or a new jacket
can change who you meet.
act:
Eat fried tofu, said to be
a fox's favorite treat
